name: Ball bounces down a dotted spiral into a problem line
looks: A small teal ball bounces down a loose dotted spiral path on a light, paper-textured ground, each bounce leaving a faint ghost trail of the ball at earlier positions, tighter near the top of the arc and wider lower down. It lands and rolls to rest beside a handwritten-style headline that begins to type on.
build: squash-stretch-ball-demo for the fall and bounce (trailing ghost copies from earlier positions at falling opacity, squash/stretch along velocity on each impact); bounce-path-draw's progressive line reveal traces the ball's spiral path behind it.
sound: A soft thump per bounce, lighter each time, then a tick as the headline starts typing.
prompt: Open with real physics, not a generic entrance: a small ball bounces down a loose spiral, each bounce leaving a faint trail of its own ghost positions, before rolling to rest beside a handwritten-style problem statement that starts to type on.
